title: A deep learning ensemble framework for multi-subtype renal tumor classification using contrast-enhanced CT.
summary: Ensemble CNN/LSTM/image-feature classifiers evaluate contrast-enhanced CT from 280 patients with biopsy-confirmed renal tumors across benign/malignant and histological subtypes; reported accuracies range from 91.2% to 100% for subtype tasks. This is retrospective diagnostic validation against histopathology in one cohort; performance estimates are limited by sample size/split and not clinical deployment.
